products.title: Rosehip & Neroli Body Oil
products.description: A lightweight body oil pressed from rosehip and sweet almond, scented with neroli. Absorbs without residue; 100ml amber glass bottle.

products.title: Overnight Facial Serum
products.description: A concentrated night serum with squalane and niacinamide for dry and combination skin. Apply three drops after cleansing.

products.title: French Green Clay Mask
products.description: A powdered clay mask blended with kaolin and chamomile. Mix one teaspoon with water and leave for ten minutes.

products.title: Mineral Bath Salts
products.description: Magnesium-rich bath salts with lavender and cedarwood. Two generous handfuls per bath; 500g refillable tin.

products.title: Shea & Oat Lotion Bar
products.description: A solid lotion bar of shea butter, colloidal oat and beeswax for very dry skin. Warm between palms before applying.

products.title: Beeswax Lip Balm
products.description: An unscented lip balm of beeswax, castor oil and vitamin E in a slim brass-look tube.

products.title: Rosemary Hand Cream
products.description: A fast-absorbing hand cream with rosemary and glycerin, formulated for frequent washing. 75ml tube.

products.title: Coffee & Sea Salt Body Scrub
products.description: An exfoliating scrub of ground coffee, fine sea salt and coconut oil. Use twice weekly on damp skin.

products.title: Camellia Cleansing Balm
products.description: A melting cleansing balm with camellia oil that removes sunscreen and makeup. Emulsifies with warm water.

products.title: Rose Water Face Mist
products.description: A steam-distilled rose water mist for setting makeup or refreshing skin through the day. 100ml.

products.title: Jojoba Cuticle Oil
products.description: A jojoba and vitamin E cuticle oil in a 10ml roller bottle. Apply nightly to nail beds.

products.title: Bergamot Shampoo Bar
products.description: A sulphate-free solid shampoo bar with bergamot and coconut-derived surfactants. Lasts roughly sixty washes.

products.title: Cedar Beard Oil
products.description: A grooming oil of argan and jojoba scented with cedar and black pepper. 30ml dropper bottle.

products.title: Woodsmoke Soy Candle
products.description: A hand-poured soy candle with woodsmoke and vetiver in a reusable ceramic vessel. Around 45 hours burn time.

products.title: Speckled Ceramic Candle Holder
products.description: A wheel-thrown stoneware holder for standard taper candles, finished in a speckled oatmeal glaze.

products.title: Beeswax Taper Candle Set
products.description: A set of six pure beeswax tapers, hand-dipped and unscented. Each burns approximately eight hours.

products.title: Linen Room Spray
products.description: A room and linen spray with fig leaf and white tea, made without synthetic fixatives. 150ml.

products.title: Brass Matchbox Cover
products.description: A solid brass matchbox cover with a striker panel, sized for a standard household matchbox.

products.title: Wick Trimmer
products.description: A stainless steel wick trimmer with an angled plate for cutting wicks to the recommended 5mm.

pages.about: Thistle & Vine began as a candle studio working out of a converted garage and has grown steadily since. We make in small batches, we test everything on ourselves first, and we keep our range tight enough that we can stand behind every item in it. Everything is poured, blended or assembled by our own team.
pages.refund_policy: Unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened skincare and body-care items cannot be returned for hygiene reasons unless faulty. Faulty items are replaced or refunded in full, including return postage.
pages.shipping_policy: Orders are dispatched within 2 business days. Standard delivery is 3-5 business days at a flat rate of $6.00, free over $60. Express delivery is 1-2 business days at $14.00.
